Commentary.Commentary: So that is all we have from this match, Sri Lanka go 1-0 up in this 3-match series. The second ODI will be played on 18th January at 2.30 pm IST (9 am GMT). Do join us for the same. Till then, Adios!

Dasun Shanaka, the skipper of Sri Lanka, starts by thanking the crowd who came to support. Says the chase was a big one but his batters showed maturity and chased it down. Tells that chasing a big total becomes a concern when you are one batter short but they will work on it in the next game.

Craig Ervine, the skipper of Zimbabwe says that they are disappointed to not come with a win. Adds that their batters did well but still feels like they were 10-20 runs short. Tells that they just need to bowl in tight areas.

Dinesh Chandimal is the Man of the Match, he says that he is over the moon about his performance but would have loved to finish off the game. He states that there has been up and down in his career and adds that thankfully things are working for him now.  He says that he is trying to be old Chandimal and he used to play like this when he was young and he is happy with his cricket now.
... The Presentation ...

Earlier in the day, it was the openers Takudzwanashe Kaitano and Regis Chakabva who gave a good start for Zimbabwe but it was William's century that boosted them to 296. At one stage it looked like a defendable one but their bowlers were not on the mark. Stay tuned for the presentation.

It felt like Zimbabwe were missing an experienced bowler. They used 8 different bowlers but most were part-time. There was never a phase where Zimbabwe held tightly and showed some threat. They did found wickets at regular intervals but the next batter came in and build the partnership with ease. Only Blessing Muzarabani and Richard Ngarava showed menace and bowled with some intent but other than that it was a tiring day for the bowlers. A bad toss to win one reckon for Zimbabwe.

The pitch was flat and easy to play on as the game progressed. Sri Lanka did not have any major hiccups to chase this huge target. A quite cozy one. It was their openers who gave them a solid start. Kusal Mendis was playing so beautifully but fell through. Nissanka stayed though with Chandimal and together both build a partnership of 66. Nissanka was all set to continue but perished and then Charith Asalanka  joined and stitched a partnership with Chandimal. One thing Sri Lanka did well was they did not hasten and took their time to settle in. There was once a period where the boundaries dried up but the singles were coming along nicely and that made Lanka's job easier.

The Hosts kick off the series with a win as they go 1-0 up quite comfortably. Zimbabwe will feel they were a bowler short or the ones they had needed to put some pressure on the batters as it was an easy chase in the end.

NO BALL! FOUR! Chamika Karunaratne finishes the chase in style! A shorter length delivery around middle and leg by Blessing Muzarabani. Chamika Karunaratne stays deep in his crease and pulls it strongly towards backward square leg for a boundary. Blessing Muzarabani has overstepped too but it anyways doesn't matter. Sri Lanka win by five wickets!
A short ball and Dasun Shanaka pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length around leg. Chamika Karunaratne tucks it square on the leg side for a single.
On a length, on middle. Dasun Shanaka works it behind square on the on side for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne comes in.
Review! Charith Asalanka take the review after been given LBW. No bat involved there. Ball Tracker shows umpire's call on impact and the wickets were hitting.

OUT! LBW! Charith Asalanka departs and Richard Ngarava gets another one. Charith Asalanka will be disappointed that he could not finish the chase but it has been an entertaining innings from the young man. Back of a length around off and angling into the batter. Charith Asalanka looks to work it towards the on side but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is a huge appeal. The umpire raises his finger and Charith Asalanka reviews it. The Ball Tracker shows that it is umpire's call on impact and it is hitting the stumps. So Charith Asalanka has to walk back and Sri Lanka are five down now but with just five runs needed.
SIX! SHOT!  Richard Ngarava serves this short on middle. Charith Asalanka is already hanging on the back foot as he is expecting a short ball. He pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie.
A length ball, on off. Dasun Shanaka defends it with soft hands towards the off side for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Dasun Shanaka rides the bounce and pushes it to mid off.
A length ball, outside off and angling across at 131 kph. Dasun Shanaka tries a paddle-scoop but misses. The ball goes through to the keeper.
Richard Ngarava bowls a full ball on off. Dasun Shanaka drives it to covers.
A short delivery on middle. Dasun Shanaka firmly pulls it to fine leg for a single. Just 12 needed now from 18 balls.
A fuller delivery on off. Charith Asalanka digs it out to long off for a single.
Another shorter length delivery. Dasun Shanaka connects the pull this time and hits this towards deep square leg for a single.
Tendai Chatara replies with a short ball! A good shot ball on the middle stump line. Dasun Shanaka looks to pull but misses.
FOUR! Shot of authority from the captain! A fuller delivery on middle. Dasun Shanaka gets little across and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Dasun Shanaka rides the bounce and pushes it to backward point.
On a length, on off. Dasun Shanaka steers it to third man and gets a single. The skipper is off the mark. Just 19 needed now from 24 balls.
WIDE! Shorter and down the leg side this time. Dasun Shanaka lets it go.
Dasun Shanaka walks out now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Dinesh Chandimal departs but it is little too late for Zimbabwe. Another short delivery on the body. Dinesh Chandimal pulls it but fails to keep it along the ground. Craig Ervine at short mid-wicket takes a good diving catch to his right and Richard Ngarava gets his second wicket. End of a superb knock by the senior batter. This short ball seems to have hurried him but he has done his job.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Ervine b Richard Ngarava

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, around leg. Dinesh Chandimal looks to pull but misses and gets hit on the body.
Shorter length but at a comfortable height this time for the pull shot. Charith Asalanka does exactly that and gets a single to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Another short delivey and this one flies over the jumping keeper. Richard Ngarava goes for a short delivery on off. Charith Asalanka looks to pull but gets the top edge. The ball goes over Regis Chakabva behind the stumps for a boundary.
Shorter length delivery again angling into body. Charith Asalanka is hurried on the pull shot and the ball goes towards mid-wicket for a couple.
A good short ball on middle with steep bounce. Dinesh Chandimal looks to pull but the ball goes over him and Regis Chakabva behind the stumps makes a good stop as he jumps to catch it.
Back of a length, around off. Chandimal chops it to point this time.

FOUR! Another short ball and this time it is Dinesh Chandimal joining the party! A shorter length delivery around leg at 131 kph. Dinesh Chandimal is quick to pick the length of the ball and pulls it towards backward square leg for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Charith Asalanka works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Blessing Muzarabani bowls a short ball on middle. Charith Asalanka pulls it to backward square leg for a boundary. He is very strong on the back foot.
On a length, around off. Charith Asalanka defends it towards covers this time.
Dot to end the over! Back of a length, outside off. Chandimal cuts it to point. 37 needed now from 36 balls.
A length ball, on off. Charith Asalanka defends it towards the off side for a single.
Back of a length, on midle. Dinesh Chandimal is early on the shot as he looks to work it away and the ball goes little aerailly towards long on for a single.
A length ball, on off. Charith Asalanka square drives it to deep cover for a single.
Another shorter length delivery outside off. Dinesh Chandimal cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, around off at 120 kph. Chandimal chops it towards point.
Length and on middle, this is pushed straight down the ground and the batters scamper across for a quick single. 41 needed in 42 balls.
WIDE! Too short, on middle. Chandimal arcs back and lets it through.
WIDE! Short but going down. Chandimal evades it.
Another short ball, on middle. Dinesh Chandimal misses his pull. We actually haven't seen too many short balls from Zimbabwean bowlers. Everything is almost on a length.
Length and on middle. Chandimal looks to work it on the leg side but mistimes it back on the turf.
Fifty for Charith Asalanka! Controlled the innings! Length and on off. Charith Asalanka guides it t through point for a single.

FOUR! Brilliant effort there though from the fielder! A short ball, on middle. Charith Asalanka looks to pull but gets a top edge towards fine leg. The fielder is stationed a bit wide and he runs across and puts a big dive and gets a hand to it but deflects it to the fence. A valiant effort that.
On middle, defended towards point.
Blessing Muzarabani (7.0-0-33-1) is back into the attack.
On middle. Blocked out. 49 needed now from 48 balls.
Slower ball, short and on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
This one stays low, on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Full and on off, pushed down to long off for a single.
On middle, pushed to mid on.
SIX! Dinesh Chandimal is in hurry now! What a shot this is! A full ball, on off. Dinesh Chandimal reaches to the pitch of the ball and heaves it all the way over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Sean Williams (7.0-0-35-0) is back into the attack.

FOUR BYES! The keeper is undone there! This is short and outside off. Charith Asalanka positions himself to guide it down but misses it. The keeper pre-meditates and follows the batter and gets undone. It goes behind him for the fence.
Darted on the pads, this is flicked to square leg for one more. The boundaries have dried up but Sri Lanka won't mind as they are getting singles with ease.
Full and on middle. Asalanka paddles it to short fine leg for a single.
Short and on leg. Asalanka makes room and slaps it through covers for a couple of runs.
On middle, Dinesh Chandimal hits it on the leg side for a single.
Shorter ball, this comes back in, on off. Chandimal looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Time for Powerplay 3! Sikandar Raza (3.0-0-18-1) is back into the attack now.
Full and on middle. Chandimal turns it to mid on for a single.
Short again, outside off. Chandimal tries to ramp it away but misses.
FOUR! Short and outside off. Chandimal hops and slashes it over point for a boundary. All the pressure that was building is faded away.
Length and onn off, Chandimal tucks it to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Length and outside off. Chandimal hops and taps it to covers. Quick single. This is so easy for Sri Lanka to get singles and keep the required run rate inside 7.
Make it 6 then! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for a run. 73 needed in 66 balls.
Five singles off the over so far! Tossed up, on off, pushed to covers for one.
This one drifts back in, on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
A single as this is tucked away through mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball, outside off. Chandimal prods and drives it to deep covers for a single.
Full, on middle, drilled down to long on for one run.
Sean Williams (6.0-0-29-0) is back into the attack.
Length and on off, this is guided to point for a quick single.
Fifty for Dinesh Chandimal! The dependable man for Sri Lanka is controlling things currently, on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Full and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, angling on off. Asalanka hits it to backward point.
On middle. Blocked out.
Length and outside off. Chandimal punches off the back foot to deep cover for a single.
Length and on off. Charith chops it to point. 83 needed in 78 balls.
Bangs a short one now, on middle, this is pulled away to square leg for one more.
On the hips, Asalanka flicks it to deep square leg and rotates the strike.
Around off, Chandimal dabs it away to third man for a single.
On middle, Asalanka pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Short in length, on middle, this is pulled late to fine leg for a single.
Length and on off. Asalanka works it to backward point.
Beaten! This one steeps off the deck. On a length and just outside off. Asalanka looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A full ball, outside off. Dinesh punches it to sweeper cover for one more.
Around off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, this is hit to square leg for a single.
Leg bye! A length ball, on off, this one nips back in. Chandimal gets hit high on the pads as he looks to flick it. A leg bye as it rolls on the off side.
WIDE! A length ball, way outside off. Chandimal chases this wide one but misses.
Back of a length, around off. Charith Asalanka punches this off the back foot to point. So a dot to end the over. Zimbabwe need wickets here.

NOT OUT! That's a good review taken by Charith Asalanka! Richard Ngarava bowls a yorker around leg. Charith Asalanka looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits his pads but it seems to be going down leg. Surprisingly, the umpire raises his finger. Charith Asalanka reviews it straightaway. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows that there is no bat involved. The Ball Tracker rolls and it shows the ball is missing the leg stump. So the decision will be overturned and Charith Asalanka survives. Good ball though by Richard Ngarava.

Review! Charith Asalanka takes the review straightaway after been given LBW. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows wickets missing and the on-field decision is overturned. Good review from him.
Back of a length and on the off stump line this time. Charith Asalanka blocks it out.
Play and a miss again! Back of a length, outside off. Charith Asalanka slashes hard at it but misses.
On a length, outside off at 134 kph. Chandimal steers it towards third man for a single.
Short and wide outside off. Chandimal slashes hard at it but misses.
A fuller delivery on off. Charith Asalanka solidly defends it towards the off side.

FOUR! Short ball and Charith Asalanka is not going to miss out. Wesley Madhevere drops this short on off. Bread and butter for Charith Asalanka as he pull it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary. 200 up for Sri Lanka.
Darted on middle and leg. Dinesh Chandimal works it to backward square leg for a single.
Shorter around off. Pushed to covers for a single.
Another full delivery on off. Dinesh Chandimal hits this hard back to the bowler. He fails to collect it cleanly and the batters run a single.
A flatter fuller delivery on off. Chandimal pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length again. Slightly outside off. Charith Asalanka cuts it to point.
Back of a length, on off. Charith Asalanka pushes this off the back foot towards the off side.
Another good shot! Back of a length, around off. Charith Asalanka punches this hard but straight to point this time.

FOUR! Shot of a champion player! Short and wide outside off. Charith Asalanka stays deep in his crease and just opens the face of his blade a little as he punches it. The ball races through backward point for a boundary. Exactly 100 needed now.
Back of a length from 'round the wicket and angling into the body. Chandimal works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, on off at 133 clicks. Charith Asalanka pulls it to mid-wicket for a single. Charith Asalanka is hurried there a little but a comforable single in the end.

DRINKS! Sri Lanka are cruising along nicely. A comfortable chase if these two keep batting like this. Zimbabwe need wickets in quick succession to create any kind of pressure here. 106 needed in 108 balls. Richard Ngarava to bowl now.
Shorter outside off this time. Charith Asalanka cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.

SIX! A really poor delivery and is rightly punished! A shorter length delivery on off. Charith Asalanka rocks back and pulls it strongly over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Zimbabwe bowlers have lacked consistency.
A fuller delivery that is fired on middle. Dinesh Chandimal eases it to long on for a single.
Slightly shorter on middle. Charith Asalanka works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Nicely tossed up on middle with hint of away turn. Charith Asalanka blocks this off the back foot.
Wesley Madhevere starts with a full delivery on off. Chandimal works it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Charith Asalanka blocks it towards the on side this time. 116 needed now from 114 balls.

FOUR! Slower delivery and punished! A  shorter length delivery on off at 94 kph this time. Charith Asalanka has all the time in the world to rock back and pull it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off at 135 kph. Charith Asalanka pulls it off the bottom of his blade to mid on.
Short and wide outside off. Chandimal cuts it too sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done by Dinesh Chandimal! Back of a length, around off. Chandimal rides the bounce and guides it fine as he plays it late towards third man for a boundary.
Short and outside the off stump. Chandimal cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Now comes down the track and works it to mid-wicket for a single. 9 coming off the over.
Slightly short, on middle, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller ball, outside off, pushed to deep point for a couple of runs.
Nicely hit but for no run! Length and outside off. Asalanaka slaps it to point.
Length and outside off, this is hit to the off side for a single.
FOUR! One bounce and into the fence. Full ball, on middle. Dinesh Chandimal skips down and heaves it to mid-wicket for a boundary.
This time Charith Asalanka tries to cut this outside off delivery but misses it completely. Tidy over from Blessing Muzarabani.
Another leave by Charith Asalanka.
Outside off. Asalnaka shoulders arms to it.
Around off. Asalanka drags it wide of deep square leg for a quick couple of runs. There was an overthrow but Asalanka overran that time.
A length ball, slanting outside off. Left alone.
A length ball, outside off. Chandimal hops and dabs it to third man for a single.
Blessing Muzarabani (5.0-0-21-1) is back into the attack.
Around off, pushed to covers for a single.
A quicker one, pushed back to the bowler.
Sees Dinesh Chandimal coming down the track and this is slower down and shorter in length, blocks to cover.
Drifts it on the pads, slower and this is hit to square leg for one.
Angels it on middle and Chandimal works it to square leg for one.
Tossed up, on off. comes down the track and hits it to mid-wicket. Good stop there.
On middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
A full toss, on off. Asalanka drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Darted on the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, pushed through the diving bowler to long on for a single.
Full and on off. Asalanka defends it to cover. He wants a single but was sent back.
Flatter ball and this is tucked away to mid-wicket.
On middle. Dinesh Chandimal keeps it out.
Angles it on the pads. Dinesh Chandimal flicks it to short fine leg where a fumble allows a brace.
Short and outside off, Chandimal cuts it to through point for a couple of runs.
On middle. Blocked out.
Flatter and on middle, it stays low as well. Asalanka steers it to short third man for a quick single.
A fuller delivery on off. Charith Asalanka drives it past driving Raza to long on for a single.
A flatter delivery and angling into middle. Charith Asalanka plays this off the back foot back to the bowler.
Charith Asalanka walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Important breakthrough for Zimbabwe and a good review taken to dismiss the set Pathum Nissanka. A flatter and slightly shorter delivery outside off by Raza. Nissanka looks to run it fine towards the off side. But the ball catches the outside edge of his blade and Regis Chakabva takes a good catch behind the stumps. He appeals and is very confident but the umpire is unmoved. Zimbabwe decide to take a review and the replays roll in. The UltraEdge shows that Nissanka has got an edge on that one and he has to walk back after playing a superb knock.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Sikandar Raza

Commentary.Commentary: Review! Zimbabwe take another review, this time for caught behind. UltraEdge shows a spike as the ball passes the blade. Good review by Zimbabwe and they finally have the breakthrough.
FOUR! Another superb shot! A full toss on off. Nissanka takes full advantage of it and creams it through covers for a boundary.
A shorter length delivery on middle. Chandimal works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Raza bowls this fuller on off. Chandimal drives it to deep extra covers for a couple.
A fuller delivery on off. Nissanka pushes it to covers now.
FOUR! Good shot! A fuller delivery on off. Nissanka takes the calclated risk and slog-sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket aerially for a boundary.
Tossed up around off. Chandimal uses his feet and works it to long on for another single.
Another single towards long on. A full ball, on middle. Nissanka eases it towards long on for a single.
Another flatter delivery on middle and leg. Chandimal pushes it to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Worked towards mid-wicket.
Raza bowls this tad wider outside off and shorter in length. Nissanka punches this off the back foot to deep extra cover for a couple. The partnership between these two is now 52.
Drifting on the pads this time. Chandimal works it to deep square leg for a single.
Slightly shorter length on off. Nissanka waits for it as he goes deep in his crease. He works it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
A fuller delivery on off. Nissanka drives it to covers this time. Dot ball.
A flatter delivery on middle and leg. Chandimal works it to square leg for a single.
Raza starts with a shorter length delivery on off. Nissanka pushes this off the back foot to long on.
Sikandar Raza is into the attack.
Another delivery that is pitched up on off. Nissanka pushes it to long off and gets a sinle. He retains the strike.
A fuller delivery, touch wider this time. Nissanka hits this firmly to deep extra cover for a couple.
A fuller delivery on off.Nicely tossed up. Chandimal skips down the track and smashes it to long off for a single.
A full delivery on off. Nissanka drives it to long off for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Chandimal defends this off the inside half of his blade towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up on off. Chandimal skips down the track and pushes it to short cover.
Fuller and on off. Nissanka guides it t o point.
On middle. Blocked out.
This one stays low, on off, pushed to point for a single.

NOT OUT! An arm ball, angling on middle and leg, fuller length there. Dinesh Chandimal prods to defend but seems to get beaten on the inside edge and gets on the pads. A huge appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire. The bowler has a chat with the skipper and convinces him to take the review. UltraEdge confirms no bat, Ball Tracker shows pitching outside off and wickets missing as well. Zimbabwe lose the review.

Review! Zimbabwe have taken a review for LBW against Dinesh Chandimal. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracker rolls and it shows that the ball is missing the leg stump. So Dinesh Chandimal survives and the original decision of NOT OUT stays.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Shorter and outside off, Nissanka works it to deep point for a single.
A single to end the over as this is eased down to long on. Sri Lanka need 178 more runs.
Outside off. Chandimal pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up, outside off, Chandimal slaps it to cover.
On middle, drilled down to long on for a single.
Given to much air this time, on off, driven hard to deep cover for a single.
On middle. Blocked out.
Full ball, outside off, tucked on the leg side.
Shorter, drifting outside off. Nissanka misses his cut.
On middle, this is hit to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller length outside off. Nissanka slaps it to deep cover for one.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Short, slower in the air and outside off. Dinesh Chandimal looks to work it to third man but misses.
Sean Williams is into the attack now.
Full and on off, pushed to the left of bowler and Wellington Masakadza puts in a dive to stop that.
Outside off, this is guided to point. Better length and line.
FOUR! Short again, on middle. Nissanka clears his front leg and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller and outside off, this is driven to sweeper cover for a single.

Fifty for Pathum Nissanka, his first in the ODI! This will give him immense confidence with the way he has played. Very good so far, he gets to the landmark by pushing this full ball down to long off for a single.
A flighted ball, outside off, driven through covers for a single.

Drinks! This has been a good steady start for Sri Lanka. The batters are looking comfortable out there as the pitch seems to be easing out. Zimbabwe have still managed to get two crucial wickets and will be looking to chip in with more wickets in these middle overs. For Sri Lanka, it is all about building partnerships and taking this game as deep as possible. Wellington Masakadza is back into the attack.
Flatter and on off. Nissanka keeps it out.
Slower and on the pads, this is tucked to deep square leg. The fielder from mid-wicket gives a chase and cuts it off. Two.
Flatter and outside off, cut away through point for one.
FOUR! 100 up for Sri Lanka! Another shorter ball, on middle. Pathum Nissanka rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Dispatched! A full toss, on middle. Nissanka heaves it to mid-wicket for a boundary. Loosener to start by Ryan Burl.
Ryan Burl is into the attack.
Back of a length, on off. Chandimal blocks it solidly.
A length ball, around off and angling away. Nissanka steers it to third man for a single.

On a length, on off and going across the batter. Chandimal dabs it to point.
Back of a length, on off. Nissanaka works it to mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! This is fuller and more wider outside off. Nissanka lets it go again.
A length delivery and angling away from the batter. Nissanka lets it go.
Slightly shorter and outside off. Chandimal chops it to point.
Shorter length again, around off. Nissanka slaps it to long off for a single.
Short and wide outside off. Chandimal cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Pushed in quicker around off. Chandimal drives it to short cover again.
Tossed up, on off. Chandimal plays it back to the bowler.
A fuller delivery on off. Nissanka drives it to deep cover for a single.
Dinesh Chandimal is the next batter in.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Kamindu Mendis departs after hitting a six off the last ball. Richard Ngarava gets his revenge. Back of  a length, around off. Mendis looks to late cut it but the ball nips back in sharply and catches the inside edge of his blade. The ball shatters the stumps and Kamindu Mendis after looking so good has to depart.
SIX! What a shot! Shorter delivery around ,middle. Mendis goes deep in his crease and pulls it sailing over backward square leg for a biggie.
Back of a length, around off. Mendis cuts it to point this time.
A fuller delivery and down the leg side. Mendis lets it go as it is way down the leg side.
A good short ball this time on middle. Mendis ducks under it.
Back of a length, on off. Mendis looks to work it towards the on side. He gets the leading edge but ball falls short of the bowler.

Tossed up delivery on off. Nissanka backs away and drives straight to short cover.
Nicely tossed up delivery on off. Pathum Nissanka drives it to covers. Spinners are key here.
A flatter delivery on leg. Mendis works it square on the leg side for a single.
A fuller delivery again. Nissanka eases down to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Mendis clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Nissanaka pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.

Richard Ngarava goes fuller on middle. Kamindu Mendis drives it to mid on this time. Dot ball again. Good over by Richard Ngarava. Sri Lanka need 231 runs more. They just need to build partnerships here.
Tight line again on off. A length delivery and Mendis blocks it out solidly.
A length ball, around off. Mendis pushes this towards cover-point. Dot ball.
Angling on the middle again. Mendis clips it towards mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Back of a length, on off. Mendis plays this off the back foot towards the bowler.
A length delivery outside off. Menids looks to cut it but misses.
Slightly shorter on off. Nissanka pushes it back to the bowler again.
Flatter on middle. Nissanka plays it back to the bowler.
TWO WIDES!  Down the leg side again. Mendis looks to clip it but misses. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and the batters run a bye behind him.
On the pads this time. Mendis works it to backward square leg.
Shorter length, on off. Nissanka punches this off the back foot to backward point for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Mendis works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly shorter on off. Nissanka pushes this off the back foot to long off for a single.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now 4 fielders are allowed outside the inner circle till the 40th over! Wellington Masakadza is into the attack.
Leg bye! Fuller ball, on middle. Pathum Nissanka misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but that was pitching outside leg.
Extra bounce and extra pace there. Length ball, angling outside off. Pathum Nissanka has a poke at it but misses.
Length and on off. Mendis is hurried as he pulls to mid-wicket. One.
On middle, this is hit to square leg for a single.

FOUR! Just over point! It looked like the fielder there got some finger-tips! A length ball, outside off. Nissanka slashes it hard and over point, it also beats the fielder running to his right in the deep. Boundary.
Short of a length, on off. Nissanka hops and defends it off the inner half onto the deck.
Richard Ngarava is into the attack.
Four dots to end then! Length and on middle, tucked away to mid-wicket.
Around off, this is hit to covers.
Fuller ball, on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Length ball, on off. Mendis chops it to backward point.
Another single as this is guided to third man.
Length and on off. Mendis plays it to third man for a single.
Length and outside off, cut away to point.
FOUR! Two in a row! Pathum Nissanka now taking the charge! Short in length, on middle. Nissanka rides the bounce and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. 50 up for Sri Lanka.
FOUR! Timing! A length ball, way outside off. Nissanka rocks back and slaps it through cover-point for a boundary.
Fuller length and outside off. Nissanka punches it to the left of the bowler.
Pathum Nissanka blocks this out solidly.
Full and angling on the pads, this is flicked wide of deep square leg for a couple.
Length and on off. Defended out.
Bangs a short one, on middle. Kamindu Mendis sits under it.
Kamindu Mendis walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Zimbabwe get the breakthrough and it is of Kusal Mendis who was looking so good. Credit to Blessing Muzarabani, he uses his height as he generates some extra bounce here. On a length, outside off. Kusal Mendis looks to cut but gets a faint outside edge to the keeper who pouches it comfortably. Zimbabwe will feel a bit relaxed now.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Wow, pierces through the gap! Short of a length, on middle. Kusal Mendis pulls, does not power it but just drags it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Angles it on a length, on off. Defended.
Length and on off. Nissanka chops it to third man for a single.

FOUR! Yet another boundary and with class all over it! A full ball, on middle. Kusal Mendis plants his front foot out, not big but just enough for it to push wide of mid on for a boundary. Beautiful shot.
On middle. Blocked out.

FOUR! Sublime! It feels like the pitch has almost flattened up and it is coming very nicely on the blade, Taking away nothing from how good these two have started! A length ball, outside off. Mendis threads it through point for a boundary.
On off, a fuller length, this is pushed to mid off with soft hands.
Length ball, outside off. Mendis taps it to point.
A length ball, outside off, Mendis pushes it nicely but straight to cover.

FOUR! A boundary to end the over! Class written all over it! Blessing Muzarabani goes fuller on middle. Pathum Nissanka leans forward and presents the full face of his blade. The ball races past the diving mid on fielder for a boundary. This has been a good start for Sri Lanka.
A length ball, around off. Nissanka drives this off the outer half of his blade to point.
A length ball, on off. Nissanka blocks this off the back foot.
Good running! A length ball, on off. Mendis defends it with soft hands towards the off side and call straightaway for a single. They get the single easily in the end.
Short and wide outside off. Mendis cuts it hard but straight to Ryan Burl at point.
A length ball, drifting on middle and leg. Nissanka clips it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Mendis defends this off the back foot to point. Steady start for Sri Lanka.
Tendai Chatara goes fuller on off. Mendis defends this off the front froot.
WIDE! Short and wider outside off. Mendis lets it go as it is too wide.
A length ball, on off. Mendis blocks it solidly this time off the back foot.
FOUR! Short and wide, Mendis punishes it! Chatara bowls this shorter outside off. Mendis stays deep in his crease and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
FOUR! Beautifully played! An overpitched delivery on middle. Mendis leans forward and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Uses his wrists to a good effect.
On a length, on off. Mendis blocks it solidly from his crease.
Another back-of-a-length delivery on off to end the over. Nissanka rides the bounce and blocks it towards the off side.
A shorter length delivery on off. Nissanka pulls it to square leg.
Slightly fuller on off. Nissanka looks to drive but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Back of a length, on middle. Nissanka rides the bounce and pushes it towards the leg side.
Quick single! Back of a length, on middle. Mendis works it to mid-wicket and sets off for a single. The fielder collects it and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A single taken.
A length ball, drifting on the pads. Nissanka clips it to square leg for a single. Good fielding there.
This one nips back in a little. A length delivery on off. Mendis looks to defend but the ball nips back in and hits him high on the pads.
Finally a fuller delivery, on off. Mendis drives it to mid off.
Back of a length, around off. Mendis dabs it to backward point.
On a length, on off. Mendis blocks it off the back foot. This one stays little low and hits the bottom of the blade.

FOUR! Short ball and punished! Mendis is off the mark in his comeback innings with a superb shot. Back of a length, outside off. Mendis stays deep in his crease and cuts it through covers for a boundary.
On a length and a bit of away shape there. Mendis plays it late towards the point fielder.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Tendai Chatara.
FOUR! What a shot! Back of a length, outside off. Nissanka stays upright in his crease and drives it on the up through covers for a lovely boundary. First boundary of the innings.
Short and some width offer this time. Nissanka cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Back of a length, on off. Nissanka blocks this off the back foot again.
Blessing Muzarabani hits the length hard yet again and bowls this on middle. Nissanka hops and works it past square leg for a couple. Sri Lanka and Pathum Nissanka are underway.
On a length and angling into middle. Nissanka defends it onto the turf again.
Blessing Muzarabani starts with a back-of-a-length delivery on off. Nissanka blocks it solidly off the back foot.
